Headline: "Oil price, WTI, Brent: U.S.-Iran fighting pause holds"

Oil prices FELL Tuesday 28 July 2026 even after the Saudi oil-facility drone attacks, as the US-Iran fighting pause held and Iran held Strait of Hormuz discussions with Saudi Arabia and Oman.
Brent crude futures fell 3.9% to $84.91 a barrel.
US West Texas Intermediate (WTI) dropped 3.3% to $79.87 a barrel.
The pause in fighting appeared to hold Tuesday, raising hopes for de-escalation.

Goldman Sachs analysts: Brent should moderate to $80 a barrel by year-end "if Hormuz fully reopens" by the final three months of the year, but Red Sea disruptions and attacks on Saudi oil infrastructure "may pose a new source of upside risk" for crude and refined-product prices.
